Self-hosted font files under app/assets/fonts/

Families: DM Sans, Inter, Luxurious Roman, Noto Naskh Arabic
Source: Fontsource CDN builds of the Google Fonts OFL releases
       (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/fontsource/fonts/…)
License: SIL Open Font License 1.1
         https://openfontlicense.org/

These WOFF2 files are vendored for same-origin delivery. Weights are limited
on purpose (storefront DM Sans 300/400/500/700; admin Inter 400/500/600/700/800;
Arabic 400/600; display Luxurious Roman 400).
